name: Embedded Figures
shortcutSummary: Look at the question figure and mentally overlay it on each option figure. The embedded figure must be present as-is (same size, same orientation, no rotation) within the complex figure.
conceptExplanation: Embedded Figure questions show a simple figure (X) and ask in which complex figure X is hidden/embedded. The simple figure must appear exactly as shown — same size and orientation — within the complex figure.

subtopics.name: Embedded Figures — Core Concepts
subtopics.explanation: Embedded Figure questions show a simple figure (X) and ask in which complex figure X is hidden/embedded. The simple figure must appear exactly as shown — same size and orientation — within the complex figure.
shortcuts: Overlay Method: Mentally place the simple figure on top of each option.
Same Orientation: The embedded figure cannot be rotated or resized — it must appear exactly as given.
Edge Matching: Look for matching edges/lines in the complex figure that form the simple figure.

practiceQuestions.questionText: From the given answer figures, select the one in which the Question Figure (X)—representing a capital letter "Z" shape with right angles—is exactly embedded / hidden:
options: Figure (B) featuring circular interlocking rings
Figure (C) consisting of an architectural window frame
Figure (A) containing a zig-zag step ladder structure
Figure (D) depicting a kite and geometric lattice
practiceQuestions.hint: Trace the critical structural angles (e.g. 90-degree corners, diagonals) of the question figure within the options.
practiceQuestions.explanation: The distinctive two horizontal parallel arms connected by a transversal diagonal in letter "Z" are seamlessly embedded inside the step ladder lines of Figure (A).
practiceQuestions.solutionSteps:
Step 1: Isolate the essential vertex angles and stroke proportions of the question figure.
Step 2: Scan each candidate figure to check if all line segments exist in the exact required orientation.
Step 3: Conclude that Figure (A) containing a zig-zag step ladder structure houses the exact embedded figure.
